answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity with slashing: activating an identity locks a copper stake of earned coins that vests only through weeks of verified work, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes plus a thousand waiting periods, while an honest agent pays once and amortizes it to zero. Newcomers enter through a quill of signed vouches from long-lived identities, each vouch risking the voucher's own stake; when correlated behavior, a comet trail of identical timing and phrasing across accounts, exposes a cluster, every stake in it is burned.
